scope: Source-only narrow visual main-merger calibration and pinned vLLM 0.18 cache API review. No provider/model/checkpoint payload action.
conclusion: No additional concrete defect found in the serialized, unchanged model-graph scope after remove_duplicate=False correction. This is not runtime or performance admission.

findings_resolved.finding: Default named_parameters enumeration suppresses duplicate aliases.
findings_resolved.resolution: Current source explicitly uses remove_duplicate=False and rejects overlapping target ranges with every other enumerated parameter.

verified: Only visual.merger.linear_fc2.weight [2048,4608] and bias [2048] are targeted; pinned Qwen3 VisionPatchMerger uses RowParallelLinear with bias=True and UnquantizedLinearMethod stores [output,input] weight. TP=1 is required and joined through the complete compatibility loader receipt, whose source checks TP/PP/DP=1, uni executor and quant_config=None.

Each gain is .98,1 or1.02; immutable CPU originals are copied/scaled separately, FP32 arithmetic returns original BF16 dtype, and each copy is read back. A partial failure blocks further non-original edits. Gain1 copies originals; no accumulated gain arithmetic.

Pinned LLM.reset_prefix_cache returns the engine bool; scheduler and KV manager propagate block_pool real True/False. A held KV block causes False, including with prefix caching disabled. Requiring is True is appropriate.

reset_mm_cache clears processor/receiver state but does not by itself invalidate encoded images. Explicit llm_engine.reset_encoder_cache clears scheduler encoder accounting and worker encoder tensors. Calls occur only after has_unfinished_requests false and exceptions prevent successful invalidation receipt.
conditions_and_limits: Caller must serialize edits, cache clearing and inference, retain the same initialized parameter graph, and admit no inference after an edit/cache failure. The helper does not independently prevent an external caller from skipping cache invalidation.
Actual runtime names/shapes/dtypes/contiguity and complete loader receipt remain fail-closed checks; pure tests do not establish actual CUDA execution or cache-memory state.
Scaling weight and bias jointly approximates a main visual output gain after BF16 rounding; no DeepStack or task-trained visual direction is supplied and no improvement is claimed.
All-parameter contiguous enumeration is conservative: unexpected noncontiguous storage will refuse rather than infer a safe alias bound.

validation.scope: Tiny fake numeric/cache-contract tests, no torch/model/provider execution; not actual BF16 hardware arithmetic.
